title: Waiting on you (B): live section — home-waiting fragment, shared keyed card merge, one rulings tick
description:
Session **B** of LIN-4144 (Home's Waiting on you live refresh). This covers plan pieces 2–4 plus the docs and test updates. It is the live section the asker sees. It lands after A (LIN-4241, the settled-ruling guard), because the refresh makes a stale card rare and the guard makes it harmless.

## Implemented (stub; the plan slice is archived)

Pieces 2–4 plus the docs and test updates of LIN-4144's approved plan were implemented as approved in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281>) (squash commit `ee8ec42e2d235e932e6ba43bf6860c96fcbe64e0`, merged and deployed 5 Nov 2026): the `home-waiting` fragment route (`{ html, count }`, owner only) over one shared reduction, the shared keyed merge `QuestionCards.mergeWaitingCards` with `cardHoldsInput` / `keepsReaderPlace`, and one `runRulingsTick` for the interval and `visibilitychange`. No deviations from the plan (the keep gate is extracted as `keepsReaderPlace`, shared by the merge and `keepTypedQuestion`). Placement of the other Home parts stays with LIN-4243. The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots (captured 2026-11-05T01:44:19Z), and the history in the comment trail (reviews, revision, close-out).

**Out of scope:** Observation (piece 6, LIN-4238), a reduction shared by the badge and Home, and placement consistency (session C).

**Session fit: fits one session.** The plan deliberately groups pieces 2–4: the fragment, merge and tick are only verifiable together as the live feature, and each is small.

**Grounding commit:** LinearViewer `main` at `476d9ad478ede67da5cb44195ce24c98d07afa61` (the plan and its review were both written against it; re-checked unchanged at breakdown, 4 Nov 22:40Z).

**Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4144's approving plan-review (comment** `7ad6c803-0434-496e-b1aa-0a9d7d36f0ab`**, rev 1).**

comments.body:
LIN-4242 implemented: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281 (branch `feat/lin-4242-live-waiting-section`, commit 5c9e8f0a, based on main with LIN-4241).

- Verified: full Playwright suite 1990 passed; full unit suite 23152/23153, the one failure (key-state census, new `waitingStanding` factory) fixed and classified not-state, census now passes; CI on the PR is green (unit tests, four E2E shards, secret scan, ci-success).
- Witnesses: unit tick test and E2E merge test each fail when the behaviour is mutated (captured, reverted).
- Not covered: fake-DOM unit test for the keyed merge (E2E covers it in a browser); cost not timed on the 3,704-task perf shape; fragment task lines fall back to anchor.issueTitle.
- Placement (Running, Up next, count line's other parts) is unchanged here, per the plan's session C (LIN-4243); llms.txt states the limit.

## Review — LIN-4242

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281, head `5c9e8f0a76c5c9b6145831cbdbb64f381c903ba1` (one commit on main `94195271`, which includes LIN-4241; main has nothing newer).

CI: green on 5c9e8f0a (unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, secret scan, ci-success). Note that `playwright.config.js` sets `retries: 2` under CI, so green does not rule out the flake below.

### What I checked
- **Scope against the plan:** the 14 changed files match pieces 2–4. The route returns `{ html, count }` only, gated on `featureFlags.runControls === true` (403 otherwise). `createWaitingStanding` is shared by `createHomeRowStates` and the route. The section and count line are hidden rather than removed. Search and empty are separate hide reasons (`dataset.searchHidden` plus `syncWaitingSection`). The merge is keyed by `rulingKeyOf` on the inner card, kept nodes are left untouched, `settledKeys` is fed from `onRulingGone`, there is a single in-flight request with one queued follow-up, and `runRulingsTick` is used for both the interval and `visibilitychange`. The badge is not written from the merged count, and `main`, the section and the count line are captured once.
- **Regression:** `git log` on the touched files shows LIN-4241's `ruling-settled` path (`removeAnsweredElsewhere`) still in place. LIN-4114's focus logic is equivalent now that the section is never removed (`waitingCards > 0 && section`). LIN-4024's `keepTypedQuestion` innerHTML-equality keep is still there. No reverts were re-applied.
- **Staleness:** nothing has landed on the touched files since the ticket was created except LIN-4241, which is the PR's base.
- **Re-grep** for `after load|fixed after|stale until reload` across `public/llms.txt docs tests`: no Waiting-related stale wording is left. The hits are Live Console, papers, evidence files and the new test's own "one interval after load". `llms.txt` states the placement limit until LIN-4243.
- **Class siblings:** no other `remove()` of the section or count line is left in `public/`. The other keep path, the opened task's `keepTypedQuestion`, is handled. This is isolated beyond the ticket's own surfaces.

### Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `waiting-section.js`: drop the `hidden` class at zero | unit red ✔ |
| `waiting-section.js`: owner with zero rows returns `''` | unit red ✔ |
| `common.js`: interval calls `updateRulingsBadge` instead of `runRulingsTick` | unit red ✔ |
| `common.js`: `visibilitychange` bypasses `runRulingsTick` | unit red ✔ |
| `server.js`: remove the route's owner 403 | E2E W16 red ✔ |
| `home-row-states.js`: page inlines its own read with `liveGuard: false` (no shared function) | **unit stays green** ✘. The conformance test compares rows from seeded state that cannot tell the guard apart, and never compares the rendered page section with the fragment |
| `question-cards.js`: drop the `settledKeys.has(key)` skip (stale response re-adds a just-answered card) | **all 16 tests in lin-4242 + lin-4114 E2E green** ✘ |
| `question-cards.js`: drop the in-flight exception on removal | **all green** ✘ |
| `prompt-section.js`: drop the `sameRuling && cardHoldsInput` keep in `keepTypedQuestion` | **all green** ✘ |

### Findings
1. **Plan witness 4 (merge unit, fake DOM) is missing, and three of the behaviours it names have no witness at any level.** Nothing pins: a just-answered key is not re-added; an in-flight card survives; the opened task keeps a typed card only for the same ruling key (`keepTypedQuestion`). Also untested: one→zero→one for section and count line (the E2E only goes zero→one→zero), the single-request-in-flight queue, and focus surviving a merge (the E2E asserts value and node identity, not focus). The implementation note lists this as "not covered" and relies on the E2E, but the mutations above show the E2E does not cover these.
2. **Plan witness 3 (conformance) is weaker than specified.** The plan asks for the page section and the fragment, rendered from the same seeded state (zero, one, many; owner, member, keyless owner; one loop just outside the window), to have identical keys and identical `session-question-card` markup, with task lines compared by identifier. The test compares `rulingRows` against `ruling.rows` only, and never renders `renderPage` against `renderWaitingSection`. A page that read the standing on its own (even with `liveGuard: false`) stays green.
3. **The new E2E is flaky on the badge.** `tests/e2e/lin-4242-waiting-live.spec.js:94`, `expect(BADGE).toHaveText('1', { timeout: 15000 })`, failed 2 of 5 local runs (Received "0"). The badge only moves on the 5s interval tick, served by the 5s stale-while-revalidate `sessionsFeedCache`, so this is a timed wait in disguise. The plan says "no timed waits", and the passing runs take about 11.4s for that reason. CI's `retries: 2` hides it. Fix: drive the badge deterministically in the test, by clearing `/test/clear-sessions-feed-cache?urlKey=` after `seedRuling` and then calling `window.updateRulingsBadge(urlKey)` via `page.evaluate` before asserting. Also review whether the badge-to-0 assertions at :101 and in W12b/W14 depend on the same race.
4. **Plan-named test updates not made.** `tests/unit/lin-4114-owner-gate.test.js` was not changed. The plan asked for "an owner with zero rulings now gets an empty hidden section" through `renderPage`, which would also pin `inProgressSummaryHtml`'s `keepWrapper` hidden count-line wrapper. Nothing at the unit level pins that today. `tests/unit/lin-4114-inflight-lock.test.js` was also not updated: the plan asked for this, and its vm harness is where `dataset.answerInFlight` set/clear, including `partial` staying in flight, can be witnessed.
5. **Titles from held task facts not implemented.** The plan says the fragment's titles come from held task facts and fall back to `anchor.issueTitle`. The route passes no `titles`, so the fallback always applies. The implementation comment says this but does not record it as a plan change on LIN-4144. It is harmless for kept cards, which are never re-titled, but a newly added card's task line can differ from the page's. Either wire the held facts in (`createTaskFactsHolder` is already in `server.js`), or record the drop with its reason on LIN-4144.
6. **Cost (review note 10) not measured.** The fragment was not timed on `tests/perf/lin-4024-home-shape.spec.js` (20 rulings). It now runs every 5s per open owner tab: lean loops, then `readRulingStanding`, then card render, with no cache.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **inside** (piece 3, merge semantics): a stale response never re-adds a just-answered or dismissed key. Unwitnessed (mutation MA green). Settle before the merge with a merge unit test: call `noteSettled(k)`, then `mergeWaitingCards(body, htmlWith(k))`, and `k` must not reappear.
- **inside** (piece 3): a card whose answer is in flight survives a merge that no longer lists it. Unwitnessed (MB green). Settle before the merge with a merge unit test where the inner card has `dataset.answerInFlight='true'` and the fresh html lacks it: the node is still present and `removed` is empty.
- **inside** (piece 3, review note 7): `keepTypedQuestion` keeps a changed-markup card only when `rulingKeyOf` matches and `cardHoldsInput` holds. Unwitnessed (MC green). Settle before the merge with a test of the opened-task repaint: same key with typed text is kept; a different key with typed text is not kept.
- **inside** (piece 3): one→zero→one for section and count line; single in-flight request; focus kept. Settle before the merge with the merge/fake-DOM unit test, or an E2E extension.
- **inside** (piece 2, witness 3): page-vs-fragment markup conformance across zero/one/many, owner/member/keyless owner, and one loop outside the window. Settle before the merge with the test as specified, comparing keys and `session-question-card` markup and task lines by identifier.
- **inside** (piece 2, review note 1): the owner's count-line wrapper is drawn hidden at zero parts through `renderPage`. Settle before the merge with the `lin-4114-owner-gate` update.
- **inside** (witness 6, E2E): badge assertions deterministic. Settle before the merge: 10 consecutive local runs of `lin-4242-waiting-live.spec.js` green with `retries: 0` after the fix in finding 3.
- **inside** (piece 2): titles from held task facts. Settle before the merge: implement, or record the drop with its reason on LIN-4144.
- **inside** (review note 10, cost): fragment cost on the 20-ruling perf shape. Settle before the merge with a timing on `tests/perf/lin-4024-home-shape.spec.js` recorded on the ticket. If it is heavy, cache the standing on `sessionsFeedCache` as the plan says.
- **inside**: real-browser polling at the 5s cadence across two tabs over minutes (the E2E drives `refreshWaitingOnYou()` directly, never the interval end to end with a merge). Settle after the deploy with a manual check: two owner tabs on Home; answer in one; within about 10s the other shows "Answered elsewhere" and a typed card in it keeps its text and focus.
- **outside** (LIN-4243): placement consistency (Running, Up next, the count line's other parts). Already owned by LIN-4243; `llms.txt` states the limit. Not a condition here.

### Verdict
Request Changes. Send back to `implementation` on this task: write the missing merge-unit and conformance witnesses (findings 1, 2, 4), de-flake the badge assertions (3), and either implement held-fact titles or record dropping them (5), then time the fragment (6). The production code matches the plan and I found no behavioural defect. The gap is that several behaviours the plan names have no test that fails when the behaviour is removed.

## LIN-4242 revision: review findings answered

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281, head `1c32c9ad` (revision on the same branch; no new PR).

CI on `1c32c9ad`: green. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, secret scan and `CI success` all pass.

Local: full unit suite 23180/23180. LIN-4242 E2E 60/60 over 10 repeats with `retries=0`. LIN-4114 E2E passes. Perf timing run passes.

### Findings → fixes

1. **Merge witnesses (fake DOM).** New `tests/unit/lin-4242-waiting-merge.test.js` runs `mergeWaitingCards` over real `renderWaitingSection` markup. It covers: added key bound at server order; kept card is the same node with text and focus; in-flight card survives; just-answered key not re-added; one→zero→one; keep gate. I mutated 8 guarded behaviours. Each was caught by a named witness, and each source was restored after its run.
2. **Conformance.** `lin-4242-waiting-live.test.js`: page section equals the fragment byte for byte across zero, one, many, a ruling outside the window, and a ruling the live-run guard changes (owner only). The guard changes a row's effect, not its presence, so that scenario asserts the effect. Mutating the page to read unguarded fails it.
3. **Badge flake.** The E2E clears the rulings feed cache and reads the badge once, instead of waiting on the 5s tick. The same change is applied to the LIN-4114 spec's badge reads.
4. **Owner-gate and in-flight lock.** `lin-4114-owner-gate`: zero-ruling owner gets a hidden section and a hidden count-line wrapper. `lin-4114-inflight-lock`: `answerInFlight` is set while the write is out and cleared on success or failure, and kept on partial. Mutations of the mark and the partial guard are both caught.
5. **Held-fact titles: implemented.** The fragment route reads `taskFacts.read` (a read, no provider call) through `waitingTitlesOf`. A cold set falls back to `anchor.issueTitle`, as before.
6. **Cost.** Fragment on the 3,704-task perf shape with 20 rulings: median 5 ms, max 9 ms over 10 requests. Not heavy, so not cached on `sessionsFeedCache`.

### Changes beyond the review (each stated with its reason)

- **Merge no longer settles keys on its own removals.** Before, a card dropped by one response could never return on the page. Only this page's answer or dismiss settles a key (`RULING_GONE_EVENT`), as the plan says. A witness covers the return path.
- **Keep gate extracted** as `QuestionCards.keepsReaderPlace`, so the unit witness and `keepTypedQuestion` share one definition.

### Still open

- The `keepTypedQuestion` call site in `public/prompt-section.js` is not witnessed. Its gate is covered by unit tests, but the repaint is driven by the opened task's state poll, which needs a full state fixture. I have not faked it. Recommend a follow-up witness on the opened-task repaint.
- The full E2E suite ran in CI, not locally; only the touched specs ran locally.

## Review — LIN-4242 (re-review after the revision)

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281, head `1c32c9ad10ff6933825a6b7883ba5f371a1d0b4f` (2 commits on main `94195271`; main has nothing newer, and no touched file changed on main since the ticket was created).

CI: green on 1c32c9ad (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). Local re-run by review: the 4 touched unit files pass 42/42. The `lin-4242-waiting-live` and `lin-4114-waiting-on-you` E2E specs pass 57/57 with `--repeat-each=3 --retries=0`.

### Previous findings → state at this head
1. **Merge witnesses (fake DOM): fixed.** `tests/unit/lin-4242-waiting-merge.test.js` now catches the mutations that stayed green last round:
   - MA, dropping `settledKeys.has(key)`, goes red in *a just-answered key is not re-added*.
   - MB, dropping the in-flight skip, goes red in *…unless its answer is still in flight*.
   - Dropping the ruling-key gate in `keepsReaderPlace` goes red in *a different ruling with typed text is never kept*.
2. **Conformance: fixed.** The page section is now compared with the fragment through `renderPage`. Setting `liveGuard: false` in `createWaitingStanding` goes red (*the live-run guard is part of the one reduction…*).
3. **Badge flake: fixed.** `syncBadge` clears the feed cache and reads the badge once. The specs passed 3× with no retries (57/57).
4. **Owner-gate and in-flight lock: fixed.** Forcing `keepWrapper: false` in `render.js` goes red in the owner-gate test.
5. **Held-fact titles: implemented, but no test pins the route's wiring** (see the ledger).
6. **Cost: measured.** Median 5 ms and max 9 ms on the 20-ruling perf shape. Not heavy, so no cache is needed. Discharged.

### Changes beyond the review
- **The merge no longer settles the keys it removes itself.** This matches the plan: only `RULING_GONE_EVENT` settles a key. LIN-4241's `removeAnsweredElsewhere` still announces through that event, so a 409 `ruling-settled` card still settles its key.
- **The keep gate is extracted as `keepsReaderPlace`.** `keepTypedQuestion` now calls it. The behaviour is the same as the inline check it replaces.

Regression check: LIN-4241's `ruling-settled` path and LIN-4024's innerHTML-equality keep are both intact. Re-grep for `after load|fixed after|stale until reload`: unchanged from the last review, with no stale Waiting wording.

### Mutation checks at this head (each reverted afterwards)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| MA settled-skip, MB in-flight skip, key gate, shared `liveGuard`, `keepWrapper` | red ✔ (each above) |
| `prompt-section.js:986`: drop `\|\| keepsPlace` from `keepTypedQuestion` | **green**: 4 unit files, plus 174 E2E matching `keep\|typed\|opened\|LIN-4024` ✘ |
| `server.js` home-waiting route: `held.complete ? waitingTitlesOf…` → `false ? …` | **green**: unit and the full lin-4242 E2E ✘ |

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **inside** (piece 3, review note 7: `keepTypedQuestion` uses the same check). **Settle before the merge.** No test pins the opened task's repaint keeping a changed-markup card for the same ruling: dropping `|| keepsPlace` stays green. The gate is pinned, but the call site is not. The harness the implementer thought was missing exists for the state poll (`tests/unit/lin-4010-home-opened-task.test.js` `loadClient({ stateBody: { questionHtml } })`), but its `makeContainer().querySelector` returns null, so it cannot reach `keepTypedQuestion`. Use an E2E instead. Add to `tests/e2e/lin-4242-waiting-live.spec.js`:
  1. Seed a ruling on LOCAL-S, then open LOCAL-S on Home.
  2. Fill the question card in the opened task's state block (`[data-question-slot] [data-testid="session-question-card-input"]`).
  3. Change the same ruling's card markup. For example, enqueue a second dispatch on LOCAL-S so the live-run guard flips the card's `effect`, or anything else that changes `renderDecisionCard`'s attributes.
  4. Drive one state poll and assert the typed text survives.
  - **Distinguishing condition:** the assertion must go red with `|| keepsPlace` removed. Confirm that before keeping it.
- **inside** (piece 2: titles from held task facts). **Settle before the merge.** No test pins the route reading `taskFacts.read`. Add one line to the first test in `tests/e2e/lin-4242-waiting-live.spec.js`, right after the first `await refresh(page);`:
  `await expect(waitingCard(page, 'LOCAL-S').locator('.waiting-task-title')).toHaveText('Solo task, Todo');`
  - Review tried this line: it passes at head and fails with the route's titles forced off (it then reads the seeded `issueTitle` `LOCAL-S`).
- **inside** (live polling end to end). **After the deploy.** The E2E drives `refreshWaitingOnYou()` directly, never the 5 s interval across two tabs. Manual check: open two owner tabs on Home and answer a card in one. Within about 10 s the other tab shows "Answered elsewhere", and a card being typed into in that tab keeps its text and focus.
- **outside** (LIN-4243): placement consistency (Running, Up next, the count line's other parts). LIN-4243 owns it, and `llms.txt` states the limit. It is not a condition here.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The production code matches the plan and I found no behavioural defect. Every finding from the last round is answered except two call-site witnesses, which are test-only additions. Close-out adds both as described above, confirms each one goes red under its mutation, and re-checks CI on the new head before merging.

## Close-out — LIN-4242

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2281, squash commit `ee8ec42e2d235e932e6ba43bf6860c96fcbe64e0` on main, pinned with `--match-head-commit 45887c90b0d6d5592cd11653f821613a9a61f1e1`. Authority: the re-review's recorded Approve (head `1c32c9ad`), conditional on close-out discharging its ledger.

**Final CI state:** green on the exact merged head `45887c90` (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success`), read fresh before the merge. CI exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`), so no substitute run was needed.

**Deployed:** harbour.cat's footer reads `ee8ec42e…` (the merge commit), after showing `94195271` before the deploy.

### Changes I made after the approval (1 commit, `45887c90`, tests only, no production code touched)
All three answer the re-review's "What CI Did Not Prove" items. Each was checked red under its mutation, with the source restored afterwards.
1. **`keepTypedQuestion` call site, same ruling** (re-review ledger item 1). New E2E in `tests/e2e/lin-4242-waiting-live.spec.js`: an opened task keeps a typed card, as the same node, when the same ruling's card markup changed. Red with `|| keepsPlace` dropped from `public/prompt-section.js` (`Expected "half a sentence…", Received ""`).
2. **Same item, key gate at the call site.** A second E2E: a different ruling's card (`data-decision-id` changed) replaces the typed one. Red with the ruling-key comparison dropped from `keepsReaderPlace` in `public/question-cards.js`.
3. **Titles from held task facts** (re-review ledger item 2). One assertion after the first `refresh(page)` in the first test: the new card's task line reads `Solo task, Todo`. Red with the route's `held.complete ? waitingTitlesOf…` forced to `false ?` (received `LOCAL-S`).

The opened-task tests need the task opened before its ruling exists, because a waiting task is not a Home row. They hold the page clock (`page.clock.install`) and run the 10s state poll by `clock.runFor`, so there is no timed wait.
Local runs: the whole spec, 24/24 over 3 repeats with `--retries=0`.

### Ledger
| Item | Class | Settled by |
|---|---|---|
| `keepTypedQuestion` call site uses the same check, ruling key first | inside | Change 1 and 2 above, both mutation-checked |
| Titles from held task facts wired in the route | inside | Change 3, mutation-checked |
| Live polling end to end across two tabs (5s cadence, "Answered elsewhere", typed card keeps text and focus) | inside, after deploy | **Not run.** See below |

All earlier findings (merge witnesses, conformance, badge flake, owner-gate and in-flight-lock updates, cost: median 5 ms and max 9 ms on the 20-ruling perf shape) were discharged in the earlier review rounds.

### Post-deploy: checks run on what landed
- `https://harbour.cat/` footer shows `ee8ec42e2d235e932e6ba43bf6860c96fcbe64e0`.

### Post-deploy check NOT RUN
- **What:** two owner tabs on Home; answer a card in one; within about 10 s the other shows "Answered elsewhere", and a card being typed into there keeps its text and focus.
- **Why:** this session has no owner sign-in on harbour.cat (no session cookie), and the route is owner-only, so I could not load Home as the owner or drive two tabs. The E2E drives `refreshWaitingOnYou()`, and the interval path is covered by the unit tick test.
- **Who can run it:** the workspace owner, in about two minutes.

### Description
Archived first: a snapshot captured 2026-11-05T01:44:19Z carries the full pre-prune description (verified identical, 6877 chars). The description is pruned to a stub; the plan slice is gone, and the problem statement, out-of-scope, session-fit and plan-review lines are kept word for word.

### Follow-ups
None filed: no outside item is unowned. Placement is LIN-4243. Parent LIN-4144 stays open for LIN-4243.

## Survey 1a (round 3)

**1. Why it was difficult.** The production code was mostly right by the revision; proving it was the hard part. The change binds on three shared surfaces: `public/question-cards.js` (used by the run page, the task page and Home), the opened-task repaint in `public/prompt-section.js`, and the 5s rulings tick, which reads through a 5s stale-while-revalidate feed cache. Each one resisted being witnessed:
- The unit suite has no DOM library, so I wrote a small HTML parser and fake DOM.
- Arrays created in the vm sandbox fail `deepStrictEqual`'s prototype check.
- The badge only moves on the interval.
- The live-run guard changes a row's `effect` rather than dropping the row, so my first conformance seed tested nothing.
- One E2E witness passed under mutation because the next 5s tick cleaned up inside `expect`'s retry window. Only running the mutation showed it.

**2. What I'd do first.** Run the review's mutations myself, and read `resolveEffect` before designing seeds.

**3. What I'd tidy.**
- The fake DOM in `tests/unit/lin-4242-waiting-merge.test.js` belongs in `tests/fixtures`, so client tests stop stubbing `querySelector` selector by selector.
- The settled-key memory is a module-level Set in `question-cards.js`, fed from `app.js`. It would read better owned by the Waiting section.
- `syncBadge` is now copied into two specs.

**4. The ticket if the area were right.** "Waiting on you follows the open rulings", where keyed reconcile is already a tested shared primitive (Live Console has its own). The ticket would then have been the route plus one tick registration.

**5. What the plan got wrong.**
- The merge's removal path settled keys. That came from the code, not the plan, but the plan's "remembered" left room for it. The effect was that a card dropped by one response could never come back on the page.
- The conformance witness as specified ("one loop just outside the window") cannot catch the unguarded-read mutation. It needed a seed the guard actually changes.
- "Titles from held facts" did not say what happens when the held set is cold.
- The plan assumed the `keepTypedQuestion` keep could be tested like the rest. Its repaint is only reachable through the opened task's state poll, which needs a full state fixture. That witness is still open.

**6. What it left behind.**
- `waitingTitlesOf` has an obvious home.
- `QuestionCards.keepsReaderPlace` gathers the keep rule into one place instead of inline in `prompt-section.js`.
- The page and the fragment now share one reduction and one renderer. That got simpler.
- The fake DOM has no shared home yet.
- `syncBadge` lives in two specs.
- The perf spec logs the fragment's cost but asserts no ceiling on it.
- The opened-task repaint still has no direct witness.

**7. Did the larger scope pay?** In the build, yes. The fragment, merge and tick only verify together, and the E2E needed all three. In the revision it cost: the witness list was long, each witness needed its own harness, and one (the repaint witness) did not land. I don't know what the Survey itself recommended. I'd draw the line here: route, merge, tick and E2E in one ticket; the opened task's keep in `prompt-section.js` as its own small ticket, because it is a different surface with a different harness.
